title: Write an is_balanced function (hard)
prompt: Write a Python function `is_balanced(s)` that returns True if all parentheses, brackets, and braces in the string s are balanced and correctly nested (e.g. '([]){}' is balanced, '([)]' is not).

metadata.hard_reason: Classic stack-based problem - a naive approach that just counts opening/closing characters (rather than using a stack) will incorrectly accept '([)]' as balanced, since counts match but nesting order doesn't.
metadata.notes: Correct: uses a stack, pushing openers and popping/matching on closers, and checking type match, not just count. No sandboxed execution yet; graded manually.
